capabilities.notes: Final projected provider JSON is wire-counted before HTTP: independent 64MiB cap, input budget subtracting requested output and max(2048,ceil(5% context)). Real user/assistant content image parts (including Anthropic tool_result content) alone receive raster estimates; tool input, schema, metadata, system content, signatures and opaque state keep conservative textual/byte accounting. Pure bounded PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP header reads avoid ImageReader metadata decompression, enforce 10MiB bytes and 40M pixels, and treat genuine animation structurally. Unknown/malformed formats retain encoded-size estimate. This is local admission, never provider billing. OpenAI Chat/Responses and Anthropic call final validate after projection; Kimi/custom BASE64_ONLY uses the shared estimator after URL conversion. Handoff assets now use complete_image_media_type, preserving valid GIF/WebP while checking PNG chunk completion and IDAT/IEND, JPEG scan/end marker, GIF color-table/subblock/trailer and WebP declared RIFF/chunk lengths. Parsing is bounded and does not decode raster pixels.
